name: my-michigan-outdoors-continuity
purpose: Give returning visitors useful local continuity without accounts, hidden server profiles, privacy regressions, or preference theater.
fatalFailures: Stores exact device coordinates in the My Outdoors profile
Sends home city, ZIP, favorite regions, saved-place names, or free-text personal preferences into growth analytics
Requires an account or server-side profile to remember the visitor
Allows local memory to override an explicit shared-plan fragment
Shows unverified live-map results when a strict family, dog, or lower-barrier preference is required
Saved household/access preferences do not affect actual recommendation filtering
Returning users still have to re-enter their normal start and range in secondary planners
